strengths.summary: All 1644 delivered paths resolve through 1644 stable nodes in a complete hierarchy of 1056 main headings and 588 subheadings, with maximum depth 3.
Cross-chapter coherence is strong: 925 complete paths retrieve treatment in more than one approved intellectual unit while retaining stable path identities.
Registered locator review supports 5915 of 6222 atomic assignments, and exact displayed-to-atomic ownership reconstructs all 5056 delivered locator displays.
Eight of ten delivered cross-references resolve to substantive target heading trees; reciprocal see-also pairs remain supplementary rather than circular substitutive chains.
